title: Reaching Marrowgate and the Hollow Throne stair at almost exactly turn 650 was a coincidence of pacing, not a sign the game was 'about to end' — nothing in the UI hinted how much critical-path content (Founding Ledger, first Reeve's confession, three named endings) still remained beyond that door.
